column1: # Coding agents: what section 1 lists, the ids the report and an account run send, and where each is
# looked for. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
# Windsurf became Devin Desktop on 2 June 2026: Devin.app, the devin-desktop command, and editor data
# under Devin, not Windsurf, while ~/.codeium stays (docs.devin.ai/desktop/devin-desktop-faq).
#   name        the agent's name in the report
#   commands    its commands, separated by ;, or - for none
#   sh-install  for gird-check.sh: where it is installed, separated by ;, or - for none. A path is from
#               ~, {AS} (Application Support, or the place the OS keeps it), {GOOSE_CFG} or {GOOSE_DATA},
#               {APP_ANTIGRAVITY}, the app bundles on a Mac
#   sh-used     for gird-check.sh: the folders that change when it is used, as sh-install
#   ps-install  for gird-check.ps1: where it is installed, from ~, {LOCALAPPDATA} or {APPDATA}, or
#   ps-used     for gird-check.ps1: the folders that change when it is used, as ps-install
#   id          the id the report and an account run send: lowercase letters, digits and -
